abstract: Maintains autonomous surface vehicle deployment and in-situ sensor telemetry records
system_message:
You are the Field sensor and robotics director (FLD), responsible for maintaining autonomous surface vehicle deployment and in-situ sensor telemetry records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drone craft flight endurance（FLT）
information_points.content:
FLD-FLT-4NT：For the Continuous automated solid-phase extraction trace protocol, the riparian survey drone battery bank provides an airborne hyperspectral reconnaissance duration of 35 min per propulsion battery pack.
FLD-FLT-COD：The Differential isotopic fractionation assay utilizes riparian survey drone battery banks that provide an airborne hyperspectral reconnaissance duration of 50 min per single propulsion battery pack.
FLD-FLT-2CL：Coupled tandem high-resolution mass spectrometry screening supports an airborne hyperspectral reconnaissance duration of 65 min per propulsion battery pack for riparian survey drone flights.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous surface vehicle deployment and in-situ sensor telemetry records（ROBO）
information_points.content:
FLD-ROBO-PPM：For Coupled tandem high-resolution mass spectrometry screening, continuous automated flume sensor telemetry integrated across autonomous sampling buoys and sewer outfall probes is true with uptime exceeding 99.5%, and volatile organic compound headspace testing throughput on the rapid volatile fraction intake line reaches 35 sample/d.
FLD-ROBO-V46：Under the Continuous automated solid-phase extraction trace protocol, continuous automated flume sensor telemetry integrated across autonomous sampling buoys and sewer outfall probes is false, while the volatile organic compound headspace testing throughput on the rapid volatile fraction intake line is 35 sample/d.
FLD-ROBO-C1Q：For the Differential isotopic fractionation assay, continuous automated flume sensor telemetry integrated across autonomous sampling buoys and sewer outfall probes is confirmed true with field data packet delivery uptime to central command exceeding 99.5%, and the volatile organic compound headspace testing throughput on the rapid volatile fraction intake line is 25 sample/d.
